exposure: use of effective birth control methods
cohort: The study included 230 female solid organ transplant recipients aged 18-45 years.
finding: After transplantation, female organ recipients became more sexually active, although the frequency of sexual intercourse decreased significantly in the post-transplant period, with younger recipients and those using effective birth control showing an increase or lack of change in frequency.
cross-section timing: At enrolment, post-transplantation, with retrospective data collected on pre-transplant behaviour.
